text:
Raj (Marquee Fin): Hey team — preparing for the Marquee Fin POC. quick Qs: can you confirm whether we can do SSO (SAML) + SCIM provisioning on Hosted for a 30-day POC? Also need RBAC mapping and any domain verification steps. what's the cost delta vs Dedicated for this scope?
Elaine (AE): Short answer: yes for SAML + basic SCIM on Hosted for POC. caveats below.
Devin (SE): We can run SAML IdP on Hosted (SP-initiated or IdP-initiated). SCIM push (provision/deprovision) is supported but Hosted SCIM for enterprise accounts has token scoping and rate limits.
Elaine (AE): POC options: 1) Hosted + allowlisted IPs + encrypted payloads (fastest), 2) Dedicated reserved pool (if they need guaranteed throughput or strict data isolation). POC pricing: we can offer a limited trial credit and a week of Dedicated dev hours at no charge for evaluation.
Raj (Marquee Fin): That sounds good. They want RBAC to map Okta groups -> app roles. any examples of mapping? and domain control verification?
Marta (Solutions): RBAC mapping approach we usually suggest: Okta group -> SCIM group -> Redwood role. simplest mapping is group name -> role name. If they need attribute-based rules (e.g., title contains "manager"), we can add a small transform during POC.
Devin (SE): SCIM attribute mapping example: 
```
scimMappings: {
  "groups": {
    "okta_admins": "admin",
    "okta_readers": "viewer"
  }
}
```
Send as JSON body to our SCIM endpoint.
Marta (Solutions): Domain verification: they can either (a) add TXT record for the top-level domain we call out, or (b) if they control a managed SSO domain, we can accept proof via their IdP assertion if configured. For POC we usually do TXT + short TTL.
Raj (Marquee Fin): Security asked for encryption at rest + KMS and audit logs. can Hosted meet that?
Devin (SE): Hosted: encryption at rest yes, customer-managed KMS is available on Dedicated and Private only. Hosted uses provider-managed KMS; we provide audit logs for auth events and role changes. If customer insists on CMK, recommend Dedicated or Private.
sec-bot: Security questionnaire link: https://redwood.internal/sec-qa/marquee-fin. Please fill sections SSO, SCIM, RBAC, data residency. Required fields: SOC2 status, encryption, key mgmt, incident contact.
Elaine (AE): For pricing ask: I'll propose 30-day POC on Hosted with 50k token credit + 2 dev support days. if they want CMK or guaranteed SLA, switch to Dedicated; I can ballpark committed monthly price after we scope throughput.
Marta (Solutions): POC success criteria suggestion: (1) SAML login + group mapping works end-to-end, (2) SCIM provisioning + deprovision observed in logs, (3) 99% of auth flows <500ms on their test profile, (4) RBAC tests for 5 roles.
Raj (Marquee Fin): Can you drop a quick checklist we can share with their infra team?
Devin (SE): Checklist (one-liner items):
- Provide IdP metadata (SAML) or IdP SSO url + x509 cert
- SCIM token (scoped) and base URL
- List of Okta groups to map + desired Redwood roles
- DNS TXT value for domain verification (if using DNS method)
- Expected request rate (RPS) for user provisioning
- Contact for troubleshooting (SSH/SSO logs access)

Marta (Solutions): I'll create a short one-page POC runbook and drop it to the thread before EOD.
Elaine (AE): I'll include the pricing blurb and optional Dedicated uplift numbers.
Raj (Marquee Fin): Perfect. can we schedule a 30-min kickoff tomorrow? timezone EST.
Marta (Solutions): free 10–11am EST.
Elaine (AE): I'll book 10:30am and invite Devin + security lead.
Devin (SE): I'll bring SCIM sample payloads and a test script.
sec-bot: Note: for Hosted POCs, SCIM rate limit default = 60 req/min; request increase via support ticket if >100/min.
Raj (Marquee Fin): Great — thanks everyone. I'll fill the security form and drop IdP metadata after the kickoff. :thumbsup:
